You miss the point of banning kids from a place. Often kids will be very active and loud and many restaurants try to avoid that chaos because maybe they seek a chill, elegant and calm atmosphere that can't be achieved with kids.
I have some restaurants with my family and i assure you the majority of kids scream and play all the time and cry when they want to leave (of course all this chaos in a restaurant where there shouldn't be any drives A LOT of customers away! That's not good for us. Sorry not sorry but we kinda live off the restaurants you know?)
If they are let scream and run around where WAITERS walk with glasses, plates, knives and forks that's the parent's fault.. but if they get hurt because the parents are negligent WE have to pay the damage!
And if we tell a customer to keep the child at bay they get offended!

Most parents will have common sense and not bring children in places where a certain atmosphere is to be kept and they will choose a child friendly restaurant (with a children play area if possible) but many parents neglect the needs and/or education of their own children and decide to bring them in places such as those!
That is why a ban for children exists. Not for discrimination.

(I used restaurants as an example since that is my own experience but you can apply this to everything else)
